title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text: Demands that Russia immediately, safely and unconditionally return all deported and forcibly transferred Ukrainian children back to unoccupied Ukraine; insists that the return of children is an obligation under international law and must never be used as a bargaining instrument or made conditional upon territorial concessions, prisoner exchanges or other political agreements;
